rationale: The plan correctly identifies perfect confounding, refuses to fit batch or apply ComBat/SVA/RUV, runs ~condition with DESeq2/limma-voom on raw counts, demonstrates aliasing, and stamps every artifact with the confounding caveat, which matches the reference. Weaknesses: PCA is deferred to Step 2 after the DE test rather than preceding it, with no library-size check or outlier policy; no low-count filter is stated at all (only DESeq2's zero-variance drop); normalization (size factors/TMM) is never named explicitly; the reference level is not set; BH is not named. Enrichment is unasked but defensible as a technical-signature diagnostic, yet the ranking metric is ambiguous (-log10 p is unsigned), no ORA universe is specified, and no collection version is given. The report lacks package versions and explicit tested/significant gene counts.
